Sandbox_SuQingPortals_TransferCost_toolt: Paid entirely at departure. Default 2; range 0.5 to 4. Batteries remain reusable. Four full batteries fund 8 trips at 0.5, 2 trips at 2, or 1 trip at 4. Arrival still needs neither batteries nor power.
Sandbox_SuQingPortals_ChargePerHour: Total gate charge per game hour (full-battery equivalents)
Sandbox_SuQingPortals_ChargePerHour_tool: Total charging rate for the whole gate, not each slot. Default 0.5; range 0.05 to 4. Four empty batteries take 8 game hours; recharge time per trip depends on its energy cost (4 hours at the default cost of 2). Charging occurs only while this gate is loaded and locally powered; unloaded/offline time earns no charge.
